_comment: Non-component exports the authored previews need to render a component truthfully — e.g. a zustand store whose DEFAULT state makes the component return null (ServerIndicator, ServerChip, ServerSettings, ServerPickerPanel all read useTransportStore). Read by .design-sync/gen-entry.mjs and merged into .ds-entry.ts. Kept out of config.json because the converter validates its top-level keys strictly. These are hooks/stores, so the converter's isComponentName filter keeps them OUT of the component list; they simply ride along on window.GawkApp for previews to drive.
